gc.ID, gc.CONTRACT_NO, gc.APPLICATION_ID, gc.COMPANY_ID, gc.GUARANTOR_ID, gc.GUARANTEED_PARTY_ID, gc.CREDITOR_ID, gc.CONTRACT_TYPE, gc.GUARANTEE_TYPE, gc.GUARANTEE_METHOD, gc.GUARANTEE_AMOUNT, gc.CURRENCY, gc.GUARANTEE_RATIO, gc.CONTRACT_START_DATE, gc.CONTRACT_END_DATE, gc.MAIN_CONTRACT_NO, gc.MAIN_CONTRACT_AMOUNT, gc.GUARANTEE_SCOPE, gc.GUARANTEE_CONDITIONS, gc.PERFORMANCE_CONDITIONS, gc.BREACH_LIABILITY, gc.DISPUTE_RESOLUTION, gc.CONTRACT_STATUS, gc.SIGNING_DATE, gc.EFFECTIVE_DATE, gc.TERMINATION_DATE, gc.TERMINATION_REASON, gc.COUNTER_GUARANTEE_REQUIRED, gc.COUNTER_GUARANTEE_TYPE, gc.COUNTER_GUARANTEE_AMOUNT, gc.MARGIN_REQUIRED, gc.MARGIN_RATIO, gc.MARGIN_AMOUNT, gc.MARGIN_ACCOUNT, gc.RISK_LEVEL, gc.RISK_ASSESSMENT, gc.APPROVAL_STATUS, gc.APPROVER_ID, gc.APPROVAL_DATE, gc.APPROVAL_COMMENTS, gc.CREATED_BY, gc.CREATED_TIME, gc.UPDATED_BY, gc.UPDATED_TIME, gc.ORGID, c.COMPANY_NAME, g.COMPANY_NAME AS GUARANTOR_NAME, gp.COMPANY_NAME AS GUARANTEED_PARTY_NAME, cr.COMPANY_NAME AS CREDITOR_NAME, a.STAFF_NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, cu.STAFF_NAME AS CREATE_USER_NAME

LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY c ON gc.COMPANY_ID = c.ID LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY g ON gc.GUARANTOR_ID = g.ID LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY gp ON gc.GUARANTEED_PARTY_ID = gp.ID LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY cr ON gc.CREDITOR_ID = cr.ID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF a ON gc.APPROVER_ID = a.ID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF cu ON gc.CREATED_BY = cu.ID
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS gc
WHERE gc.APPLICATION_ID = #{applicationId} ORDER BY gc.CREATED_TIME DESC

SELECT
FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS gc
WHERE gc.COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} ORDER BY gc.CREATED_TIME DESC

SELECT
FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS gc
WHERE gc.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'EFFECTIVE' AND gc.CONTRACT_END_DATE < SYSDATE
AND gc.ORGID = #{orgId}
ORDER BY gc.CONTRACT_END_DATE DESC

SELECT
FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS gc
WHERE gc.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING'
AND gc.ORGID = #{orgId}
ORDER BY gc.CREATED_TIME ASC
SELECT CONTRACT_STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CONTRACT_STATUS
SELECT CONTRACT_STATUS AS status, SUM(GUARANTEE_AMOUNT) AS amount FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CONTRACT_STATUS

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 END) AS draftCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 'EFFECTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS effectiveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 'TERMINATED' THEN 1 END) AS terminatedCount, SUM(GUARANTEE_AMOUNT) AS totalAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 'EFFECTIVE' THEN GUARANTEE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS effectiveAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_END_DATE < SYSDATE AND CONTRACT_STATUS = 'EFFECTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS expiredCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_END_DATE BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + 30 AND CONTRACT_STATUS = 'EFFECTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS expiringCount FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}
SELECT #{prefix} || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(CONTRACT_NO, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1))), 0) + 1, 8, '0') FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS WHERE CONTRACT_NO LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS SET CONTRACT_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}

UPDATE TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS SET APPROVAL_STATUS = #{approvalStatus}, APPROVER_ID = #{approverId}, APPROVAL_DATE = SYSDATE, APPROVAL_COMMENTS = #{approvalComments}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS SET CONTRACT_STATUS = 'SIGNED', SIGNING_DATE = #{signingDate}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS SET CONTRACT_STATUS = 'EFFECTIVE', EFFECTIVE_DATE = #{effectiveDate}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}

UPDATE TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS SET CONTRACT_STATUS = 'TERMINATED', TERMINATION_DATE = #{terminationDate}, TERMINATION_REASON = #{terminationReason}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS SET CONTRACT_STATUS = 'CANCELLED', UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}

UPDATE TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS SET CONTRACT_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID IN
#{id}
